courses.title: Acid Peptic Disease & GERD
courses.subtitle: From mucosal defense to modern acid suppression
courses.description: Comprehensive evidence-based CME course on gastroesophageal reflux disease, erosive esophagitis, refractory heartburn, and modern acid suppression protocols including Potassium-Competitive Acid Blockers (P-CABs).

modules.title: Understanding APD & GERD
modules.summary: Pathophysiology, Montreal definitions, and the clinical spectrum of erosive vs non-erosive reflux disease.

lectures.title: What is GERD? Classification & Regional Burden
lectures.summary: Montreal consensus definitions, physiological vs pathological acid reflux, and epidemiological disease burden in South Asia.

lectures.title: Pathophysiology of Esophageal Mucosal Injury
lectures.summary: Transient lower esophageal sphincter relaxations (TLESRs), epithelial junction breakdown, and acid-pepsin synergy.

lectures.title: Endoscopic Evaluation: The Los Angeles (LA) Classification
lectures.summary: Grading mucosal breaks from LA Grade A to D and identifying patients needing long-term maintenance therapy.

modules.title: Acid Suppression Pharmacology & P-CABs
modules.summary: Mechanism of PPIs, limitations in nighttime control, and the clinical role of Potassium-Competitive Acid Blockers.

lectures.title: Proton Pump Inhibitors: Pharmacokinetics & Clinical Gaps
lectures.summary: CYP2C19 genotypes, delayed onset, meal-timing compliance, and nocturnal acid breakthrough.

lectures.title: Vonoprazan & The P-CAB Paradigm Shift
lectures.summary: Reversible competitive K+ antagonism, meal independence, prolonged 24-hour pH > 4 maintenance, and clinical efficacy in severe erosive esophagitis.

lectures.title: Optimizing Acid Suppression in Severe Erosive Esophagitis
lectures.summary: Dosing strategies, switching protocols, and managing severe Grade C/D erosive disease.

modules.title: Refractory Symptoms & Extra-Esophageal GERD
modules.summary: Diagnostic workup for persistent heartburn and atypical ENT/pulmonary presentations.

lectures.title: Stepwise Workup of Refractory GERD
lectures.summary: Stepwise clinical workup: verifying adherence, 24-hour impedance-pH monitoring, and excluding motility disorders.

lectures.title: Extra-Esophageal Syndromes: Cough, Laryngitis & Asthma
lectures.summary: Recognising micro-aspiration and vagal reflexes, multidisciplinary ENT co-management, and realistic expectations of acid suppression.

modules.title: Complications, Barrett's Esophagus & Follow-Up
modules.summary: Peptic strictures, screening protocols for Barrett's esophagus, and long-term surveillance.

lectures.title: Barrett's Esophagus: Prague Criteria & Biopsy Rules
lectures.summary: Identifying intestinal metaplasia, calculating circumferential and maximal extent (Prague C & M), and surveillance intervals.

lectures.title: Peptic Stricture Prevention & Endoscopic Dilation
lectures.summary: Endoscopic balloon dilation, aggressive post-dilation acid inhibition, and dysphagia monitoring.

lectures.title: Patient Education, Lifestyle & De-escalation
lectures.summary: Weight reduction, head-of-bed elevation, tapering strategies, and reassurance for benign dyspepsia.

courses.title: Primary Care Dyspepsia & H. pylori
courses.subtitle: Recognise early, test accurately, eradicate cleanly
courses.description: Essential primary care pathway for managing uninvestigated dyspepsia, Rome IV criteria for functional dyspepsia, non-invasive H. pylori diagnosis, and first-line eradication.

modules.title: Dyspepsia Triage & Alarm Features
modules.summary: Differentiating organic disease from functional dyspepsia and identifying urgent referral red flags.

lectures.title: Uninvestigated Dyspepsia in Primary Care
lectures.summary: Clinical presentation, epigastric pain vs postprandial fullness, and the test-and-treat strategy.

lectures.title: Red Flags & Urgent Endoscopy Referral
lectures.summary: Weight loss, anemia, persistent vomiting, dysphagia, and age cutoffs for fast-track endoscopy.

modules.title: H. pylori Testing & Quadruple Eradication
modules.summary: Selecting reliable tests and overcoming high regional clarithromycin resistance.

lectures.title: Diagnostic Modalities: Urea Breath Test & Stool Antigen
lectures.summary: Why serology fails, the 2-week PPI and 4-week antibiotic washout rules, and test accuracy.

lectures.title: First-Line Eradication: Bismuth Quadruple Regimens
lectures.summary: Formulating 14-day Bismuth Quadruple Therapy (PPI, bismuth, tetracycline, metronidazole) to counteract macrolide resistance.

lectures.title: Confirming Cure & Salvage Therapies
lectures.summary: Post-treatment verification timing (minimum 4 weeks) and second-line levofloxacin/P-CAB triple regimens.

modules.title: Functional Dyspepsia & Long-Term Care
modules.summary: Managing Postprandial Distress Syndrome (PDS) and Epigastric Pain Syndrome (EPS).

lectures.title: Rome IV Functional Dyspepsia Subtypes
lectures.summary: Tailoring therapy: acid suppression for EPS vs prokinetics and gut-brain neuromodulators for PDS.

lectures.title: NSAID Co-Prescribing & Gastric Protection
lectures.summary: Assessing ulcer bleeding risk, prophylactic PPI/P-CAB co-prescription, and cardiovascular vs GI safety trade-offs.

courses.title: Advanced Endoscopic Interventions
courses.subtitle: Acute Hemostasis, EMR, and Enteral Stenting
courses.description: Specialist-level masterclass in advanced interventional endoscopy: acute upper GI bleeding control, mucosal resection (EMR), dysplastic Barrett's ablation, and stricture management.

modules.title: Non-Variceal Upper GI Bleeding Hemostasis
modules.summary: Risk scores, Forrest classification, and multi-modal endoscopic hemostatic techniques.

lectures.title: Emergency Resuscitation & Risk Stratification
lectures.summary: Glasgow-Blatchford Score, pre-endoscopy high-dose IV acid suppression, and timing of urgent endoscopy.

lectures.title: Endoscopic Hemostatic Modalities
lectures.summary: Dual therapy: adrenaline injection plus mechanical hemoclips or thermal coagulation, and topical hemostatic powders.

modules.title: Endoscopic Mucosal Resection & Barrett's Ablation
modules.summary: Resection of superficial mucosal lesions and radiofrequency ablation for dysplastic Barrett's esophagus.

lectures.title: Upper GI EMR Principles & Technique
lectures.summary: Submucosal injection, snare resection, margins assessment, and managing intraprocedural bleeding.

lectures.title: Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA) in Barrett's Neoplasia
lectures.summary: Indications for RFA in confirmed low-grade and high-grade dysplasia, post-ablation acid suppression, and surveillance protocols.
